This is a projectile motion problem. At the highest point of its trajectory, the vertical component of the ball's velocity is momentarily zero. The horizontal component of velocity remains constant throughout the flight, as air resistance is ignored. The speed at the top is therefore equal to the initial horizontal velocity, calculated as = * cos(theta) = 10 * cos(30 degrees) which is approximately 8.7 m/s.
